measures.id: Special City of Omaha Election — $155,000,000 Public Facilities Bonds
measures.title: $155,000,000 Public Facilities Bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether the City of Omaha may issue $155 million in general obligation bonds to acquire, build, improve, equip and rehabilitate police buildings, fire stations, branch libraries, park maintenance facilities, auditorium, arena and convention center support facilities, public works storage facilities and other city buildings. The bonds would be repaid, with interest, from the City's fund for debt payments. The ballot states that approval will not increase the City's debt service tax levy rate beyond the levy increase approved in 2020.
measures.yesMeans: The City of Omaha may issue up to $155 million in general obligation bonds for these public facilities.
measures.noMeans: The City of Omaha may not issue these bonds.

measures.id: Special City of Omaha Election — $30,000,000 Park & Recreation Bonds
measures.title: $30,000,000 Park & Recreation Bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether the City of Omaha may issue $30 million in general obligation bonds to pay for various park and recreation improvement projects. The bonds would be repaid, with interest, from the City's fund for debt payments. The ballot states that approval will not increase the City's debt service tax levy rate beyond the levy increase approved in 2020.
measures.yesMeans: The City of Omaha may issue up to $30 million in general obligation bonds for park and recreation projects.
measures.noMeans: The City of Omaha may not issue these bonds.
